text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
Another step forward toward my dream today!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Thanks to visiting Furlong Tower, I'm more fired up than ever!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Have you ever seen the view from the observation deck?
It's incredible. It's just so vast and endless—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Making my name known in such a huge world,
becoming the ace who smashes preconceptions—when I thought about that, it really snapped me into focus!
It looks like Katsuragi Ace had a very fulfilling break!
